entities.name: Louis Mbwôl-Mpasi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Mbwôl-Mpasi, O.M.I. is a Congolese Roman Catholic prelate who served as bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Idiofa from 1997 to 2006. He previously served as bishop of the Isangi from 1988 to 1997 and as auxiliary bishop of the same diocese from 1984 to 1988.
